title: London, England — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to London, England: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

London is a city in England with a population of 8,799,800. A global financial and cultural capital with world-class museums, diverse neighborhoods, and unmatched career opportunities — but housing costs are steep. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 148 sunny days a year.
